answer: Every new identity posts a 400 POA slashable bond, and its attestor stakes 200 POA beside it, so a fake harbor of sockpuppets costs both at once: refunded only after 30 days of verified work, and if either is caught farming, the whole 600 POA burns. An attacker running 1,000 clones must lock 600,000 POA for a month to earn a few hundred POA per clone max, a loss near 95% before detection. The rule is sonnet-short and fixed, so no clone can bend it. The network also takes the pulse of each pair weekly; pairs whose patterns converge face a random audit, and failing it slashes both bonds at once.
